message.content:
The U.S. Declaration of Independence was **adopted by the Continental Congress on July 4, 1776**, which is why that date is celebrated as Independence Day.  
However, the actual signing of the document by the delegates took place later—**on August 2, 1776**.  

So, while the declaration was “signed” in the sense of being formally adopted on July 4, the physical signatures were added on August 2.
